InitialMarginPortfolioCode.name: Initial Margin Portfolio Code
InitialMarginPortfolioCode.definition: Specifies the unique code assigned by the reporting counterparty to the portfolio if the collateral is posted on a portfolio basis.||Usage:|NoCode is reported if the collateralisation was performed on a transaction level basis, or if there is no collateral agreement or if no collateral is posted or received.
